fun_facts: In 2023, Jayden Maiava threw for 3,085 yards and 17 touchdowns at UNLV, and also ran for 277 yards and three scores.
In his first USC start, Jayden Maiava threw three touchdown passes and ran for another in a 28–20 win over Nebraska.
Jayden Maiava opened the 2026 season with 286 passing yards, two passing touchdowns, and a rushing score in USC’s 42–26 win over San José State.
In USC’s 30–18 upset of No. 2 Ohio State, Jayden Maiava connected with Trent Mosley for a 69-yard touchdown on the game’s second snap.
Jayden Maiava is from Honolulu, Hawaii, and played high school football at Kaimuki High School.

# Jayden Maiava passes for 3 TDs, runs for another in debut start to lead USC past Nebraska, 28-20

By AP

Nov 16, 2024, 09:20 pm

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

LOS ANGELES -- — [Jayden Maiava](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4685454/jayden-maiava) passed for 259 yards and three touchdowns and ran for another score in his first start for [Southern California](https://apnews.com/hub/southern-california-trojans-football) , leading the Trojans to a 28-20 victory over slumping [Nebraska](https://apnews.com/hub/nebraska-cornhuskers-football) on Saturday.

[Woody Marks](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4429059/woody-marks) rushed for 146 yards for USC (5-5, 3-5 Big Ten), and [Maiava capped his eventful debut start](https://apnews.com/article/usc-jayden-maiava-quarterback-35c9f7f35d3ec3ca0bf72aa3283a679a) by making a 2-yard TD run with 2:45 to play.
